members.name: banking77
members.instructions: Which intent best describes this message from a customer of a digital bank's support chat? Pick the single most specific intent. Distinguish carefully between similar intents: asking how to do something vs reporting a problem; fees vs unrecognised transactions; pending vs failed vs declined vs reverted; card payments vs cash withdrawals vs transfers vs top-ups.

criteria.activate_my_card: Asks how to activate / start using a newly received card (activation, 'my card is not active yet').
criteria.age_limit: Asks about the minimum age or age requirements to open or hold an account (children, under 18, teenagers).
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Asks about using Apple Pay or Google Pay (setup, support, adding card to them, topping up with Apple Pay).
criteria.atm_support: Asks where ATMs are, how to find a nearby ATM, or which ATMs can be used.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Asks about the automatic top-up feature: enabling, disabling, how auto top-up works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The user's own balance has not changed after a bank transfer into the account; money sent hasn't shown up in the balance or account. Also the recurring wording 'what is the time frame for a transfer from a UK account, after just making one it doesn't appear / isn't showing up'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit was made but the balance has not updated / deposit not showing.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add or send to a beneficiary / recipient; the beneficiary is not allowed or rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or payment they made to someone (a mistaken transfer).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring soon or has expired; asks about renewal or getting a replacement for expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted, whether it works at merchants/stores/online shops or in some places.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not come / is missing, asks where it is, how to track it (tracking number), 'haven't received my card'. Default for a complaint that a card has not arrived, including 'ordered weeks ago and still not here' when the complaint is that it is missing.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Mainly asks HOW LONG or WHEN card delivery takes: expected delivery time, express delivery, how the card will be sent, 'when can I expect it' as a request for a date.
criteria.card_linking: Asks how to link or connect an existing card to the app or account.
criteria.card_not_working: Vaguer: 'my card doesn't work' / 'something wrong with my card' / 'I can't use my card', with no explicit decline and no specific type of failure (not contactless, not virtual, not ATM).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Was charged a fee on a card payment (a purchase), asks why a fee was added to a card payment.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Sees a card payment / purchase in their account they do not recognise or did not make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment (purchase) in foreign currency had a wrong or bad exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM / machine swallowed, kept or ate the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Was charged a fee on a cash withdrawal at an ATM, asks about withdrawal fees/charges.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Sees a cash withdrawal they do not recognise or did not make.
criteria.change_pin: Asks how to change, set, find, get or reset the card PIN, including where the PIN is / has not been received / cannot be seen (a PIN is not a card: not card_arrival).
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects card details were compromised/used fraudulently by someone else, card has been hacked or misused, someone is using the card without permission (not simply lost or stolen).
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap payments are not working.
criteria.country_support: Asks which countries are supported: where an account can be opened or the service is available; also generic 'Can I get support?' type messages asking whether support exists for them / their country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment / purchase was explicitly declined, rejected, refused or not accepted in a shop, online or at a restaurant, including 'why was my card declined'.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise or did not authorise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Asks about limits or restrictions on disposable virtual cards.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Asks how to change or update personal details (name, address, phone number, email, date of birth).
criteria.exchange_charge: Asks about fees / charges for exchanging currencies.
criteria.exchange_rate: Asks what the exchange rate is, or how exchange rates are determined (general question).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Asks about exchanging currency in the app, or whether currency exchange can be done via the app.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Sees an unexpected extra charge or unknown amount on the statement (e.g. an extra £1), asks why they were charged extra.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / did not go through (error, unsuccessful).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Asks which fiat currencies are supported for holding, exchanging or transferring.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Asks how to get / create a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Asks how to get a physical card (where to get one, 'I need a physical card'), generally.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Asks about getting a spare or additional / second card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Asks how to get a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card has been lost, misplaced or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone (with the app) has been lost or stolen; worried about account security on the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants to order a physical card (ordering process, ordering a replacement or new card).
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the passcode (app/login passcode) or is asking how to reset it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending / still showing as pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / still showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, 'not sure it went through', 'funds not available yet', 'topped up but didn't seem to complete', money not yet credited, top-up not completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is pending or still in progress, or has taken a long time / waited a long while for it to complete.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked, e.g. after entering the wrong PIN too many times; card locked.
criteria.receiving_money: Asks how to receive money (into the account) from others, e.g. bank details for receiving a payment.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that was expected has not shown up in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase / payment, asks how to get a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed, cancelled or returned by the merchant; also some 'my payment wasn't accepted / didn't work' messages.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards and currencies are supported (e.g. for top-up, which card types or currencies).
criteria.terminate_account: Wants to close or delete their account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks about fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Asks about fees or charges for topping up by card (or was charged a fee when topping up by card).
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Asks about topping up with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up did not work, was denied, or the card was declined for a top-up; error on top-up.
criteria.top_up_limits: Asks about limits on top-ups (maximum or minimum amount).
criteria.top_up_reverted: Money was credited by a top-up and then disappeared, or the top-up was returned / cancelled / reversed (but if the top-up was by card and money disappeared, prefer topping_up_by_card).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Asks how to top up using a card (process, steps), or reports that after topping up by card the money disappeared / balance didn't change.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: A transaction or payment was charged twice / duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Was charged a fee on a transfer, asks why a transfer fee was applied.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Asks how to transfer money into the account / add money by transfer from another bank (how-to).
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer was sent but a named recipient (friend, landlord, son, merchant) has not received it; also some generic 'transfer is taking too long to arrive' messages.
criteria.transfer_timing: General question how long a transfer takes (esp. incoming money from the US / Europe / abroad), when a transfer will arrive, time frame for transfers. Not about the user's own balance missing a transfer.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Cannot or fails to verify identity (verification not working, failed, rejected).
criteria.verify_my_identity: Asks how to verify identity / what is needed for identity verification (process).
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Asks about verifying the source of funds / proof of where money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Asks about verification of a top-up, e.g. verifying the card used for top-up, verification code/ 3D secure for a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether cards are Visa or Mastercard / which network, or can choose between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asks why identity verification is required / needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Received a wrong amount of cash from an ATM (less or more than requested).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal (ATM) in foreign currency had a wrong or bad exchange rate.
